items.title: Missing User and Shipment Volumes
items.description: The customer has not provided expected user counts or shipment volumes to size the portal infrastructure.

items.title: Clarify User and Shipment Volumes
items.description: What are the expected numbers of active portal users and daily shipment tracking requests?
items.why_it_matters: This determines the infrastructure sizing, performance requirements, and hosting costs.

items.title: Standard Mid-Market Volumes
items.description: We assume the portal will support up to 5,000 active customers and 10,000 daily tracking requests.
items.impact_if_wrong: Underestimating volumes will lead to performance degradation, while overestimating will increase hosting costs.

items.title: Unspecified TMS and Finance Systems
items.description: The specific systems and API capabilities for the TMS and Finance integrations are not defined.

items.title: Identify TMS and Finance Systems
items.description: What are the specific product names, versions, and API capabilities of your TMS and Finance systems?
items.why_it_matters: Integration complexity and effort depend heavily on the specific systems and their available APIs.

items.title: Modern REST APIs Available
items.description: We assume both the TMS and Finance systems expose modern, documented REST APIs for integration.
items.impact_if_wrong: If legacy integration methods are required, integration effort and timeline will increase significantly.

items.title: Undefined Payment Gateway
items.description: The preferred payment gateway provider for online invoice payments has not been specified.

items.title: Select Payment Gateway
items.description: Which payment gateway provider should be integrated for online payments?
items.why_it_matters: The choice of gateway affects integration complexity, PCI compliance scope, and transaction fees.

items.title: Stripe Integration
items.description: We assume Stripe will be used as the payment gateway, utilizing hosted checkout to minimize PCI compliance scope.
items.impact_if_wrong: Using a custom or legacy payment provider will increase development effort and security compliance overhead.

items.title: Unspecified Target Platform
items.description: The target cloud platform or hosting environment for the portal has not been defined.
items.absence_note: not mentioned in the customer input

items.title: Confirm Target Cloud Platform
items.description: Do you have a preferred cloud provider or hosting environment for the portal?
items.absence_note: not mentioned in the customer input
items.why_it_matters: This dictates the deployment architecture, infrastructure-as-code tooling, and operational costs.

items.title: AWS Cloud Hosting
items.description: We assume the portal will be hosted on AWS using standard serverless or containerized services.
items.impact_if_wrong: A change in cloud provider would require rewriting deployment scripts and potentially changing architectural components.

items.title: Missing Security and Compliance Requirements
items.description: Specific security baselines, authentication standards, and compliance requirements are not defined.
items.absence_note: not mentioned in the customer input

items.title: Define Security and Authentication Standards
items.description: Are there specific security standards or authentication requirements we must adhere to?
items.absence_note: not mentioned in the customer input
items.why_it_matters: Security and compliance requirements heavily impact the architecture, authentication flow, and testing effort.

items.title: Standard Web Security and Auth
items.description: We assume standard web security practices and standard username/password authentication with MFA.
items.impact_if_wrong: Strict enterprise compliance or complex SSO integrations will increase delivery timelines and costs.

items.title: Undefined Project Timeline and Budget
items.description: The target go-live date and budget constraints for the portal development are unknown.

items.title: Clarify Timeline and Budget Constraints
items.description: What is your target go-live date and the allocated budget for this portal initiative?
items.why_it_matters: This helps align the project scope, phasing strategy, and resource allocation with your constraints.

items.title: Standard Implementation Timeline
items.description: We assume a standard 4-month implementation timeline for the initial MVP release.
items.impact_if_wrong: An aggressive timeline would require phasing out lower-priority features or increasing team size, impacting costs.
